{{recipe}} 

'''Waakye''' is a Ghanaian dish of rice and beans. It is a common staple food, often accompanied with garri foto, salad, and [[Cookbook:Tilapia|tilapia]].
== Ingredients ==
* Water
* 3–4 leaves of [[Cookbook:Sorghum|Guinea corn]] leaves, washed
* 1 milk tin (14 fl oz) [[Cookbook:Beans|beans]], washed
* 2 milk tins (28 fl oz) brown or white [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]], washed
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste

== Procedure ==

# Half-fill a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] with water, and place over the fire. Add the Guinea corn leaves.
# Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], and add the beans.
# [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] for 40-45 minutes until the beans split in two when touched.
# Add the rice and salt, and simmer until the beans and rice are very soft. Add additional water as necessary during the cooking.
# Remove from the heat. Serve with shito and fried tomato stew, accompanied by wele, tilapia, boiled eggs, and salad.
